messages.content: You are a helpful assistant. Put a clear separator line between paragraphs. Every divider line must be exactly: "=====". Use at most 4 paragraphs. (Paragraphs are separated by a blank line, or by divider lines if dividers are required.) Your output must begin with: "It's a good start.". Include each of these punctuation marks at least once: ['?', '!'].

Gandalf was a wizard who fought in the War of the Ring. Is that a good explanation for a 10 year old? Do not use more than 4 paragraphs. (Separate paragraphs clearly.) Use this exact divider line between paragraphs: "=====". Separate paragraphs with a visible divider line. Include each of these punctuation marks at least once: ['?', '!']. Your output must begin with: "It's a good start.".
